_comment: CORS config for the jva-safety.firebasestorage.app bucket, allowing the web app's origins to read (GET/HEAD) Storage download URLs directly (e.g. /Image.network for meeting evidence thumbnails). Not applied by `firebase deploy` — GCS bucket CORS is separate from storage.rules and must be applied via the Storage client library or gsutil: `gsutil cors set storage.cors.json gs://jva-safety.firebasestorage.app` (or the Node @google-cloud/storage bucket.setCorsConfiguration(...) equivalent, since gsutil may not be usable on every machine). Re-apply whenever the web app's hosting origin changes (a new custom domain, etc.) or a new local dev port needs to be added.
